name: Dawngate Opalthread Evening Glove
description: Floor-length opera gloves in ivory biopearl silk, woven with opalescent thread that shifts from cold blue to warm amber under different lighting conditions. The upper arm is finished with a laser-cut fretwork cuff in matching fabric, edged with micro-crystal beading sourced from New Osaka artisans. Available in a chrome-cover variant with an extra seamless inner sleeve of matte polymer that conceals chrome hands without breaking the silhouette.
functionality: Chrome-cover liner option provides seamless cosmetic concealment for chrome hands at Spire-level events. Micro-crystal edge is scratch-resistant. Biopearl silk is temperature-regulating and stain-repellent.
what_it_says: You belong in this room and you dressed for it three days in advance.
story_hooks: The chrome-cover liner of a pair left at a Spire gala contains a hidden data port — someone was running an intelligence op and left in a hurry.
A Tier 1 tailor produces near-perfect counterfeits using salvaged opalescent thread; Dawngate's legal team is hunting the source.
A synthetic attendee commissioned a custom extended version — the gloves reach the shoulder to cover non-human arm proportions, and they're the most elegant thing in the room.
